verdict.rationale: Statsig documents official Client and Server SDKs, including on-device evaluation SDKs, a JavaScript SDK tutorial, a React StatsigProvider quickstart, and server SDKs for retrieving prompts. Its HTTP API docs recommend the SDKs by default, and community users report implementing Statsig integrations. Missing for 10: an enumeration of supported languages/platforms in the evidence, and independent hands-on corroboration specific to SDK quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: After initialization, both Client and Server SDKs evaluate experiments/gates _without a network request_, and typically in less than 1ms.
